translations.text: May the yoke of God's law be on this shoulder; may the visitation of the Holy Spirit be on this head; may the sign of Christ be on this forehead; may the hearing of the Holy Spirit be in these ears; may the smelling of the Holy Spirit be in this nose; may the vision of the people of heaven be in these eyes; may the speech of the people of heaven be in this mouth; may the work of God's Church be in these hands; may the good of God and of one's neighbour be in these feet; may this heart be a dwelling for God; may this whole person belong to God the Father! The Creed and the Our Father.
